579	        /\ in_flight' = [in_flight EXCEPT ![s] =
580	                            IF m.in_flight /= NULL THEN m.in_flight ELSE NULL]
581	        \* VC state reset (but NOT committedDuringViewChange — Family 5 bug)
582	        /\ vc_quorum' = [vc_quorum EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
583	        \* Notify controller of new view (InformNewView → ViewChanged → changeView)
584	        \* Non-atomic update: step 1 (view number) — Family 3
585	        /\ ctrl_updating'      = [ctrl_updating      EXCEPT ![s] = TRUE]
586	        /\ ctrl_view_pending'  = [ctrl_view_pending   EXCEPT ![s] = m.view]
587	    /\ UNCHANGED <<ctrl_view, ctrl_decisions, log, prepare_votes, commit_votes, blacklist,
588	                   committed_during_vc, vc_delivered_seq, vc_start_dropped, hbmVars, msgs>>
589	
590	\* ─── Non-Atomic View+Decisions Update (Family 3) ─────────────────────────────
591	\*
592	\* controller.go:407-430 changeView():
593	\*   setCurrentViewNumber(newViewNumber)      line 427 — under currViewLock
594	\*   setCurrentDecisionsInView(newDecisions)  line 428 — under currDecisionsInViewLock
595	\* Between these two calls, concurrent ProcessMessages callers invoking leaderID()
596	\* see the new view with OLD decisions, computing a transiently wrong leader.
597	
598	\* Step 1: update ctrl_view (under currViewLock).  controller.go:427
599	ChangeViewUpdateView(s) ==
600	    /\ s \in Correct
601	    /\ ctrl_updating[s]
602	    /\ ctrl_view' = [ctrl_view EXCEPT ![s] = ctrl_view_pending[s]]
603	    \* ctrl_decisions still has OLD value — window begins
604	    /\ UNCHANGED <<ctrl_decisions, ctrl_updating, ctrl_view_pending, phase, log,
605	                   prepare_votes, commit_votes, in_flight, blacklist, vcVars, hbmVars, msgs>>
606	
607	\* Step 2: update ctrl_decisions (under currDecisionsInViewLock).  controller.go:428
608	ChangeViewUpdateDecisions(s, newDecisions) ==
609	    /\ s \in Correct
610	    /\ ctrl_updating[s]
611	    /\ ctrl_view[s] = ctrl_view_pending[s]   \* view was already updated in step 1
612	    /\ ctrl_decisions' = [ctrl_decisions EXCEPT ![s] = newDecisions]
613	    /\ ctrl_updating'  = [ctrl_updating  EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
614	    \* Start HBM ChangeRole
615	    /\ hbm_chg_pend' = [hbm_chg_pend EXCEPT ![s] = TRUE]
616	    /\ UNCHANGED <<ctrl_view, ctrl_view_pending, phase, log, prepare_votes, commit_votes,
617	                   in_flight, blacklist, vcVars, hbm_view, hbm_timed_out, hbm_role, hbm_artif_pending, msgs>>
618	
619	\* A correct node reads leaderID() during the non-atomic window.
620	\* controller.go:234: leaderID() reads both currViewNumber AND currDecisionsInView.
621	\* BUG (Family 3): if ctrl_updating[s]=TRUE, view was updated but decisions may be old.
622	\* This action doesn't change state; it records the observed leader for checking LeaderIdentityConsistency.
623	\* Invariant: all nodes should agree on leader given the same (view, decisions, blacklist).
624	ReadLeaderID(s) ==
625	    /\ s \in Correct
626	    /\ ctrl_updating[s]                          \* in the non-atomic window
627	    \* The read observes ctrl_view[s] (new) + ctrl_decisions[s] (old) — transiently wrong leader
628	    /\ UNCHANGED vars                            \* read-only; invariant checked on current state
629	
630	\* ─── getInFlight suppression (Family 5) ──────────────────────────────────────
631	\*
632	\* viewchanger.go:468-499 getInFlight():
633	\*   If inFlightMetadata.LatestSequence+1 == lastDecisionMetadata.LatestSequence
634	\*   AND committedDuringViewChange != nil
635	\*   AND committedDuringViewChange.LatestSequence == lastDecisionMetadata.LatestSequence
636	\* → return nil (suppress in-flight report)
637	\*
638	\* BUG: committedDuringViewChange is NEVER reset between view changes.
639	\* On a second view change, stale value can suppress a real in-flight proposal.
640	
641	GetInFlightSeq(s) ==
642	    \* viewchanger.go:458-498 getInFlight()
643	    LET ifSeq == in_flight[s]
644	        lastSeq == CommittedSeq(s)
645	    IN
646	    IF ifSeq = NULL THEN NULL
647	    ELSE IF ifSeq = lastSeq THEN NULL   \* same seq as last decision: not an actual in-flight
648	    ELSE IF ifSeq + 1 = lastSeq /\ committed_during_vc[s] /= NULL
649	             /\ committed_during_vc[s] = lastSeq THEN
650	             \* Suppression: committed during this VC — return nil
651	             \* BUG: if committed_during_vc is STALE from previous VC, this fires incorrectly
652	             NULL
653	    ELSE ifSeq
654	
655	\* ─── Crash and Recovery ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
656	
657	\* Crash resets all volatile (in-memory) state. controller.go, viewchanger.go.
658	\* Persisted state (log, checkpoint) survives; volatile state (votes, in-flight) is lost.
659	Crash(s) ==
660	    /\ s \in Correct
661	    /\ phase'          = [phase          EXCEPT ![s] = "CRASHED"]
662	    /\ prepare_votes'  = [prepare_votes  EXCEPT ![s] = [seq \in 0..MaxSeq |-> {}]]
663	    /\ commit_votes'   = [commit_votes   EXCEPT ![s] = [seq \in 0..MaxSeq |-> {}]]
664	    /\ in_flight'      = [in_flight      EXCEPT ![s] = NULL]
665	    /\ ctrl_updating'  = [ctrl_updating  EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
666	    /\ ctrl_view_pending' = [ctrl_view_pending EXCEPT ![s] = ctrl_view[s]]
667	    /\ vc_quorum'      = [vc_quorum      EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
668	    /\ vc_delivered_seq' = [vc_delivered_seq EXCEPT ![s] = NULL]
669	    /\ vc_start_dropped' = [vc_start_dropped EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
670	    \* committedDuringViewChange: in-memory (viewchanger.go:109) — reset on crash
671	    /\ committed_during_vc' = [committed_during_vc EXCEPT ![s] = NULL]
672	    /\ hbm_timed_out'  = [hbm_timed_out  EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
673	    /\ hbm_chg_pend'   = [hbm_chg_pend   EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
674	    /\ hbm_artif_pending' = [hbm_artif_pending EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
675	    /\ UNCHANGED <<ctrl_view, ctrl_decisions, log, blacklist, vc_view, hbm_view, hbm_role, msgs>>
676	
677	\* Recovery: restore from checkpoint, re-enter consensus at recovered view+seq.
678	Recover(s) ==
679	    /\ phase[s] = "CRASHED"
680	    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "NORMAL"]
681	    \* Restore view and decisions from persisted state (WAL/checkpoint).
682	    \* In simplified model, ctrl_view and ctrl_decisions are already correct (they survived crash).
683	    /\ vc_view' = [vc_view EXCEPT ![s] = ctrl_view[s]]
684	    \* HBM reset on recovery
685	    /\ hbm_view'  = [hbm_view  EXCEPT ![s] = ctrl_view[s]]
686	    /\ hbm_role'  = [hbm_role  EXCEPT ![s] = IF CtrlLeader(s) = s THEN "LEADER" ELSE "FOLLOWER"]
687	    /\ UNCHANGED <<ctrl_view, ctrl_decisions, ctrl_updating, ctrl_view_pending,
688	                   log, prepare_votes, commit_votes, in_flight, blacklist,
689	                   vc_quorum, committed_during_vc, vc_delivered_seq, vc_start_dropped,
690	                   hbm_timed_out, hbm_chg_pend, hbm_artif_pending, msgs>>
691	
692	\* ─── Next ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
693	
694	Next ==
695	    \/ \E s \in Server : Propose(s)
696	    \/ \E s \in Server : HBLeaderTick(s)
697	    \/ \E s \in Server : HBFollowerTick(s)
698	    \/ \E s \in Server : InjectArtificialHeartbeat(s)
699	    \/ \E s \in Server : HandleArtificialHeartbeat(s)
700	    \/ \E s, from \in Server : HandleHeartbeat(s, from)
701	    \/ \E s \in Server : OnHeartbeatTimeout(s)
702	    \/ \E s \in Server : MaybeStartViewChange(s)
703	    \/ \E s \in Server : HandleViewChange(s)
704	    \/ \E byz \in Byzantine, dest \in Server : ByzantineViewData(byz, dest)
705	    \/ \E s, from \in Server : ProcessViewDataDeliver(s, from)
706	    \/ \E s, from \in Server : ProcessViewDataValidate(s, from)
707	    \/ \E s, from \in Server : ProcessViewDataSameSeq(s, from)
708	    \/ \E s \in Server : BuildNewView(s)
709	    \/ \E s \in Server : EnterNewView(s)
710	    \/ \E s \in Server : ChangeViewUpdateView(s)
711	    \/ \E s \in Server : \E d \in 0..MaxSeq : ChangeViewUpdateDecisions(s, d)
712	    \/ \E s \in Server : ReadLeaderID(s)
713	    \/ \E s, from \in Server : Decide(s, from)
714	    \/ \E s \in Server : Crash(s)
715	    \/ \E s \in Server : Recover(s)
716	    \/ \E s \in Server : \E v \in 0..MaxView : \E l \in Server : SendChangeRole(s, v, l)
717	    \/ \E s \in Server : \E v \in 0..MaxView : \E l \in Server : ProcessChangeRole(s, v, l)
718	
719	Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
720	
721	\* ─── Invariants ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
722	
723	\* Min operator (not built-in in TLA+)
724	Min(a, b) == IF a <= b THEN a ELSE b
725	
726	\* Standard BFT safety: no two correct nodes commit different proposals at the same seq.
727	\* In the simplified model, proposals = sequence numbers, so we check monotonic delivery.
728	Agreement ==
729	    \A s1, s2 \in Correct :
730	        \A i \in 1..Min(Len(log[s1]), Len(log[s2])) :
731	            log[s1][i] = log[s2][i]
732	
733	\* ViewChangeSafety: committed proposals survive view changes.
734	\* If s committed seq K, the new view leader must include seq K in its state.
735	ViewChangeSafety ==
736	    \A s \in Correct :
737	        phase[s] = "NORMAL" =>
738	            Len(log[s]) = CommittedSeq(s)
739	
740	\* NoFalseTimeout (Family 1): HBM should not fire timedOut against a live leader.
741	\* A "live leader" is one in NORMAL phase, sending heartbeats in the current view.
742	\* Invariant: if hbm_timed_out[s] = TRUE, the leader in hbm_view[s] is not live.
743	NoFalseTimeout ==
744	    \A s \in Correct :
745	        hbm_timed_out[s] =>
746	            ~LeaderAliveInView(hbm_view[s])
747	
748	\* LeaderIdentityConsistency (Family 3): all correct nodes agree on leader for given (view, decisions).
749	\* During the non-atomic update window, a node sees new view + old decisions → wrong leader.
750	\* Invariant: no two correct nodes should simultaneously see different leaders for the same view.
751	LeaderIdentityConsistency ==
752	    \A s1, s2 \in Correct :
753	        (ctrl_view[s1] = ctrl_view[s2] /\ ctrl_decisions[s1] = ctrl_decisions[s2]) =>
754	            CtrlLeader(s1) = CtrlLeader(s2)
755	
756	\* DeliverImpliesViewEntered (Family 2): if a node delivered seq S during view-change processing,
757	\* the view change must eventually complete (vc_quorum reaches Quorum) or another VC starts.
758	\* Safety form: if vc_delivered_seq[s] /= NULL, the view cannot stall permanently.
759	\* Checked as: either view change completed (phase = NORMAL) or quorum was reached.
760	DeliverImpliesViewEntered ==
761	    \A s \in Correct :
762	        (vc_delivered_seq[s] /= NULL /\ phase[s] = "ENTERING_NV") =>
763	            Cardinality(vc_quorum[s]) >= Quorum
764	
765	\* InFlightReplay (Family 5): if a correct node reported an in-flight proposal during VC,
766	\* the new view must either re-propose it or it was already committed by quorum.
767	\* Checked as: GetInFlightSeq should only return NULL when semantically correct.
768	InFlightReplay ==
769	    \A s \in Correct :
770	        in_flight[s] /= NULL =>
771	            \* Either seq is already committed (in log), or GetInFlight correctly reports it
772	            \/ in_flight[s] <= CommittedSeq(s)
773	            \/ GetInFlightSeq(s) /= NULL
774	
775	\* Structural invariant: committed sequence numbers are monotonically increasing.
776	LogMonotonic ==
777	    \A s \in Correct :
778	        \A i \in 1..Len(log[s]) : log[s][i] = i
779	
780	\* Combined structural check.
781	StructuralInv ==
782	    /\ TypeOK
783	    /\ LogMonotonic
784	
785	====
786

file.content:
---- MODULE base ----
\* SmartBFT — PBFT-family BFT consensus with rotating leader
\* hyperledger-labs/SmartBFT, internal/bft/
\*
\* Category A: Distributed / Message-Passing, BFT overlay
\* Bug families modeled: F1 (HBM state isolation), F2 (deliver-before-validate),
\*                       F3 (non-atomic view+decisions update), F5 (in-flight lifecycle)

EXTENDS Integers, Sequences, FiniteSets, TLC

\* ─── Constants ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CONSTANTS
    Server,             \* All N nodes (use {1,2,3,4} in MC)
    F,                  \* Max Byzantine faults; N >= 3F+1
    Quorum,             \* ceil((N+F+1)/2); e.g. 3 for N=4
    Byzantine,          \* SUBSET Server — nodes allowed to deviate
    NodesList,          \* Ordered sequence of Server for getLeaderID
    DecisionsPerLeader, \* Decisions before leader rotation (0 = disabled)
    LeaderRotation,     \* BOOLEAN: leader rotation enabled
    MaxView,            \* Bound on view numbers for MC
    MaxSeq,             \* Bound on sequence numbers for MC
    NULL                \* Sentinel

Correct == Server \ Byzantine

\* Ordered node list for model checking — TLC cfg files cannot contain <<>> literals.
\* Use `NodesList <- MCNodesList` in all .cfg files.
MCNodesList == <<1, 2, 3, 4>>

ASSUME Byzantine \subseteq Server
ASSUME Cardinality(Byzantine) <= F
ASSUME NodesList \in Seq(Server)
ASSUME Len(NodesList) = Cardinality(Server)
ASSUME \A i,j \in 1..Len(NodesList) : i /= j => NodesList[i] /= NodesList[j]

\* ─── Type abbreviations ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Phase == {"NORMAL", "VC_STARTED", "ENTERING_NV", "CRASHED"}
HBMRole == {"LEADER", "FOLLOWER"}
MsgType == {"PREPREPARE", "PREPARE", "COMMIT",
            "HEARTBEAT", "HEARTBEAT_RESP",
            "VIEW_CHANGE", "VIEW_DATA", "NEW_VIEW",
            "COMPLAINT"}

\* ─── Variables ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

VARIABLES
    \* ── Controller goroutine state (controller.go) ───────────────────────────
    ctrl_view,          \* [Server -> Nat]: currViewNumber           controller.go:122
    ctrl_decisions,     \* [Server -> Nat]: currDecisionsInView      controller.go:125
    ctrl_updating,      \* [Server -> Bool]: TRUE between ChangeViewUpdateView and
                        \*   ChangeViewUpdateDecisions (non-atomic two-lock window; Family 3)
    ctrl_view_pending,  \* [Server -> Nat]: new view# being installed (during ctrl_updating)
    phase,              \* [Server -> Phase]
    log,                \* [Server -> Seq(Nat)]: committed seq numbers (Len = committed count)
    prepare_votes,      \* [Server -> [Nat -> SUBSET Server]]: prepare vote sets per seq
    commit_votes,       \* [Server -> [Nat -> SUBSET Server]]: commit vote sets per seq
    in_flight,          \* [Server -> Nat ∪ {NULL}]: prepared in-flight proposal seq
    blacklist,          \* [Server -> SUBSET Server]: from checkpoint metadata

    \* ── ViewChanger goroutine state (viewchanger.go) ─────────────────────────
    vc_view,            \* [Server -> Nat]: currView               viewchanger.go:105
    vc_quorum,          \* [Server -> SUBSET Server]: valid ViewData senders (Family 2)
    committed_during_vc,\* [Server -> Nat ∪ {NULL}]: committedDuringViewChange
                        \*   viewchanger.go:109 — NEVER reset between view changes (Family 5 bug)
    vc_delivered_seq,   \* [Server -> Nat ∪ {NULL}]: seq delivered during VC (Family 2 tracking)
    vc_start_dropped,   \* [Server -> Bool]: last StartViewChange was dropped (Family 5)

    \* ── HeartbeatMonitor goroutine (heartbeatmonitor.go) — INDEPENDENT ────────
    hbm_view,           \* [Server -> Nat]: hm.view                heartbeatmonitor.go:59
    hbm_timed_out,      \* [Server -> Bool]: hm.timedOut           heartbeatmonitor.go:68
                        \*   Cleared ONLY by handleCommand (ChangeRole). Bug: once set per view,
                        \*   no further timeouts fire until ChangeRole arrives.     Family 1
    hbm_role,           \* [Server -> HBMRole]: hm.follower
    hbm_chg_pend,       \* [Server -> Bool]: ChangeRole cmd in commandChan (not yet drained)
    hbm_artif_pending,  \* [Server -> Bool]: artificialHeartbeat capacity-1 channel occupied
                        \*   heartbeatmonitor.go:95 (capacity 1); drop on full channel  Family 1

    \* ── Network ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    msgs                \* Set of message records

\* Variable groups for UNCHANGED
controllerVars == <<ctrl_view, ctrl_decisions, ctrl_updating, ctrl_view_pending,
                    phase, log, prepare_votes, commit_votes, in_flight, blacklist>>
vcVars         == <<vc_view, vc_quorum, committed_during_vc, vc_delivered_seq, vc_start_dropped>>
hbmVars        == <<hbm_view, hbm_timed_out, hbm_role, hbm_chg_pend, hbm_artif_pending>>
msgVars        == <<msgs>>
vars           == <<controllerVars, vcVars, hbmVars, msgVars>>

\* ─── Helper operators ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

N == Len(NodesList)

\* getLeaderID: util.go:72-99
GetLeaderID(view, decisions, bl) ==
    IF ~LeaderRotation THEN
        NodesList[(view % N) + 1]
    ELSE
        LET base == view + (decisions \div DecisionsPerLeader)
        IN CHOOSE node \in Server :
            /\ node \notin bl
            /\ \E i \in 0..(N-1) :
                /\ NodesList[((base + i) % N) + 1] = node
                /\ \A j \in 0..(i-1) : NodesList[((base + j) % N) + 1] \in bl

\* Leader as seen by a node's Controller (uses its own ctrl_view, ctrl_decisions, blacklist)
CtrlLeader(s) == GetLeaderID(ctrl_view[s], ctrl_decisions[s], blacklist[s])

\* Leader as seen by HBM (uses its own hbm_view; HBM always passes decisions=0: viewchanger.go:232)
HBMLeader(s) == GetLeaderID(hbm_view[s], 0, {})

\* Current next-to-commit sequence at node s (0-based; Len(log[s]) = number committed)
CommittedSeq(s) == Len(log[s])

\* Whether a quorum of nodes is in NORMAL phase at a view (leader is "alive" for invariant checking)
LeaderAliveInView(v) ==
    \E leader \in Correct :
        /\ GetLeaderID(v, 0, {}) = leader
        /\ phase[leader] = "NORMAL"
        /\ ctrl_view[leader] = v

\* Message send/discard helpers
Send(m)    == msgs' = msgs \cup {m}
Discard(m) == msgs' = msgs \ {m}

\* Check whether a ViewData outer signature is valid (modeled as a field in the message)
\* Byzantine nodes may send VIEW_DATA with outer_valid = FALSE to trigger Family 2 bug
OuterSigValid(m) == m.outer_valid

\* ─── TypeOK ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

TypeOK ==
    /\ ctrl_view         \in [Server -> Nat]
    /\ ctrl_decisions    \in [Server -> Nat]
    /\ ctrl_updating     \in [Server -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ ctrl_view_pending \in [Server -> Nat]
    /\ phase             \in [Server -> Phase]
    /\ log               \in [Server -> Seq(Nat)]
    /\ in_flight         \in [Server -> Nat \cup {NULL}]
    /\ blacklist         \in [Server -> SUBSET Server]
    /\ vc_view           \in [Server -> Nat]
    /\ vc_quorum         \in [Server -> SUBSET Server]
    /\ committed_during_vc \in [Server -> Nat \cup {NULL}]
    /\ vc_delivered_seq  \in [Server -> Nat \cup {NULL}]
    /\ vc_start_dropped  \in [Server -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ hbm_view          \in [Server -> Nat]
    /\ hbm_timed_out     \in [Server -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ hbm_role          \in [Server -> HBMRole]
    /\ hbm_chg_pend      \in [Server -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ hbm_artif_pending \in [Server -> BOOLEAN]

\* ─── Init ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Init ==
    /\ ctrl_view         = [s \in Server |-> 0]
    /\ ctrl_decisions    = [s \in Server |-> 0]
    /\ ctrl_updating     = [s \in Server |-> FALSE]
    /\ ctrl_view_pending = [s \in Server |-> 0]
    /\ phase             = [s \in Server |-> "NORMAL"]
    /\ log               = [s \in Server |-> <<>>]
    /\ prepare_votes     = [s \in Server |-> [seq \in 0..MaxSeq |-> {}]]
    /\ commit_votes      = [s \in Server |-> [seq \in 0..MaxSeq |-> {}]]
    /\ in_flight         = [s \in Server |-> NULL]
    /\ blacklist         = [s \in Server |-> {}]
    /\ vc_view           = [s \in Server |-> 0]
    /\ vc_quorum         = [s \in Server |-> {}]
    /\ committed_during_vc = [s \in Server |-> NULL]
    /\ vc_delivered_seq  = [s \in Server |-> NULL]
    /\ vc_start_dropped  = [s \in Server |-> FALSE]
    /\ hbm_view          = [s \in Server |-> 0]
    /\ hbm_timed_out     = [s \in Server |-> FALSE]
    /\ hbm_role          = [s \in Server |-> IF GetLeaderID(0, 0, {}) = s THEN "LEADER" ELSE "FOLLOWER"]
    /\ hbm_chg_pend      = [s \in Server |-> FALSE]
    /\ hbm_artif_pending = [s \in Server |-> FALSE]
    /\ msgs              = {}

\* ─── Normal-Path Actions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

\* Leader proposes the next request. controller.go:484-496, view.go leader path.
Propose(s) ==
    /\ s \in Correct
    /\ phase[s] = "NORMAL"
    /\ ~ctrl_updating[s]
    /\ CtrlLeader(s) = s                          \* I am the leader: controller.go:227-230
    /\ CommittedSeq(s) < MaxSeq                   \* bound for MC
    /\ LET seq == CommittedSeq(s) + 1
       IN
       /\ Send([type    |-> "PREPREPARE",
                view    |-> ctrl_view[s],
                seq     |-> seq,
                digest  |-> seq,
                sender  |-> s])
    /\ UNCHANGED <<controllerVars, vcVars, hbmVars>>

\* Follower receives PREPREPARE, stores in-flight, broadcasts PREPARE.
\* view.go HandleMessage/pre-prepare path.
HandlePrePrepare(s) ==
    /\ s \in Correct
    /\ phase[s] = "NORMAL"
    /\ \E m \in msgs :
        /\ m.type = "PREPREPARE"
        /\ m.view = ctrl_view[s]                  \* view.go: check view matches
        /\ m.seq  = CommittedSeq(s) + 1           \* view.go: check seq is next
        /\ m.sender = CtrlLeader(s)               \* view.go: from current leader
        /\ in_flight[s] = NULL                    \* not already prepared
        /\ in_flight' = [in_flight EXCEPT ![s] = m.seq]
        /\ Send([type   |-> "PREPARE",
                 view   |-> m.view,
                 seq    |-> m.seq,
                 digest |-> m.digest,
                 sender |-> s])
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ctrl_view, ctrl_decisions, ctrl_updating, ctrl_view_pending,
                   phase, log, prepare_votes, commit_votes, blacklist,
                   vcVars, hbmVars>>

\* Node receives PREPARE, accumulates votes; when quorum, broadcasts COMMIT.
\* view.go prepare vote accumulation.
HandlePrepare(s, from) ==
    /\ s \in Correct
    /\ phase[s] = "NORMAL"
    /\ from /= s                                  \* view.go: don't self-count
    /\ \E m \in msgs :
        /\ m.type   = "PREPARE"
        /\ m.sender = from
        /\ m.view   = ctrl_view[s]
        /\ m.seq    = CommittedSeq(s) + 1
        /\ from \notin prepare_votes[s][m.seq]    \* not already counted
        /\ prepare_votes' = [prepare_votes EXCEPT ![s][m.seq] =
                                prepare_votes[s][m.seq] \cup {from}]
        /\ IF Cardinality(prepare_votes'[s][m.seq]) >= Quorum - 1 THEN
               \* Reached prepare quorum: store in-flight, broadcast COMMIT
               /\ in_flight' = [in_flight EXCEPT ![s] = m.seq]
               /\ Send([type   |-> "COMMIT",
                        view   |-> m.view,
                        seq    |-> m.seq,
                        digest |-> m.digest,
                        sender |-> s])
           ELSE
               /\ UNCHANGED <<in_flight, msgs>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ctrl_view, ctrl_decisions, ctrl_updating, ctrl_view_pending,
                   phase, log, commit_votes, blacklist, vcVars, hbmVars>>

\* Node receives COMMIT, accumulates votes; when quorum, decides (commits to log).
\* view.go commit vote accumulation. controller.go:537-567 decide().
Decide(s, from) ==
    /\ s \in Correct
    /\ phase[s] = "NORMAL"
    /\ \E m \in msgs :
        /\ m.type   = "COMMIT"
        /\ m.sender = from
        /\ m.view   = ctrl_view[s]
        /\ m.seq    = CommittedSeq(s) + 1
        /\ from \notin commit_votes[s][m.seq]

\* Min operator (not built-in in TLA+)

# SmartBFT Trace Instrumentation Guide

## Instrumented Events

| Event | Source File | Function / Location |
|---|---|---|
| `propose` | `internal/bft/controller.go` | Leader proposes a new request |
| `decide` | `internal/bft/controller.go` | Node reaches decision on a sequence number |
| `update_view` | `internal/bft/controller.go` | Current view number is updated |
| `update_decisions` | `internal/bft/controller.go` | Decisions map is updated after commit |
| `pre_prepare` | `internal/bft/view.go` | PrePrepare message is processed |
| `view_change_start` | `internal/bft/viewchanger.go` | Node initiates a view change |
| `vc_deliver` | `internal/bft/viewchanger.go` | ViewChange message is delivered |
| `vc_validate` | `internal/bft/viewchanger.go` | ViewChange quorum is validated |
| `vc_same_seq` | `internal/bft/viewchanger.go` | View change for same sequence detected |
| `enter_new_view` | `internal/bft/viewchanger.go` | Node enters a new view after VC completes |
| `hb_timeout` | `internal/bft/heartbeatmonitor.go` | Leader heartbeat timeout fires |
| `change_role` | `internal/bft/heartbeatmonitor.go` | Node role changes (leader/follower) |

## How to Add a Field to an Existing Event

1. Find the `Emit(...)` call for the event in the source file listed above.
2. Add the new key-value pair to the map passed to `Emit`.
3. Re-run `bash /Users/tess/dev/Specula/case-studies/smartbft/.specula-output/harness/run.sh`.

## How to Add a New Event

1. Find an existing `Emit(...)` call near the location you want to instrument.
2. Copy the block and paste it at the new location.
3. Change the `"event"` key value to the new event name.
4. Add or remove fields as needed.
5. Re-run `bash /Users/tess/dev/Specula/case-studies/smartbft/.specula-output/harness/run.sh`.

## How to Rebuild

```
bash /Users/tess/dev/Specula/case-studies/smartbft/.specula-output/harness/run.sh
```

This resets the repo, re-applies the patch, rebuilds, runs tests, and reports trace line counts.

## Note on hb_timeout

The `hb_timeout` event fires only when `LeaderHeartbeatTimeout` elapses without a heartbeat from
the leader. Use `TestTLATraceHBTimeout`, which drives a manual/fake clock to trigger the timeout
without waiting for wall-clock time.

# SmartBFT Trace Instrumentation Guide

## Instrumented Events

| Event | Source File | Trigger Point |
|---|---|---|
| `propose` | `internal/bft/view.go` | After `v.HandleMessage(v.LeaderID, msg)` in `Propose()` — leader only |
| `pre_prepare` | `internal/bft/view.go` | After `v.inFlightProposal = &proposal` in `processProposal()` — all nodes |
| `decide` | `internal/bft/controller.go` | After `c.incrementCurrentDecisionsInView()` in `decide()` — all nodes |
| `update_view` | `internal/bft/controller.go` | After `c.setCurrentViewNumber()` in `changeView()` |
| `update_decisions` | `internal/bft/controller.go` | After `c.setCurrentDecisionsInView()` in `changeView()` |
| `hb_timeout` | `internal/bft/heartbeatmonitor.go` | Before `hm.handler.OnHeartbeatTimeout()` in `followerTick()` |
| `change_role` | `internal/bft/heartbeatmonitor.go` | After all field updates in `handleCommand()` |
| `view_change_start` | `internal/bft/viewchanger.go` | After the `select { case v.startChangeChan <- ...: ...; default: }` in `StartViewChange()` |
| `vc_deliver` | `internal/bft/viewchanger.go` | After `v.deliverDecision()` in `checkLastDecision()` (seq+1 branch) |
| `vc_validate` | `internal/bft/viewchanger.go` | After `v.Verifier.VerifySignature()` in `checkLastDecision()` (seq+1 branch, right after vc_deliver) |
| `vc_same_seq` | `internal/bft/viewchanger.go` | After `v.Verifier.VerifySignature()` in `checkLastDecision()` (same-seq branch) |
| `enter_new_view` | `internal/bft/viewchanger.go` | After `v.Controller.ViewChanged()` in `processNewViewMsg()` |

## File Locations After apply.sh

- `internal/bft/tla_trace.go` — trace emitter (mutex-protected global writer)
- `internal/bft/controller.go` — `propose`, `decide`, `update_view`, `update_decisions` emits
- `internal/bft/view.go` — `pre_prepare` emit
- `internal/bft/viewchanger.go` — `view_change_start`, `vc_deliver`, `vc_validate`, `vc_same_seq`, `enter_new_view` emits
- `internal/bft/heartbeatmonitor.go` — `hb_timeout`, `change_role` emits + `SelfID` field
- `pkg/consensus/consensus.go` — sets `leaderMonitor.SelfID` so HBM events have correct node ID
- `test/tla_trace_scenarios_test.go` — 4 test scenarios

## How to Add a Field to an Existing Event

1. Find the `TLATrace.Emit(map[string]interface{}{...})` block for the event in the file listed above.
2. Add the new key-value pair to the map.
3. Run `bash /Users/tess/dev/Specula/case-studies/smartbft/.specula-output/harness/run.sh`.

## How to Add a New Event

1. Find an existing `TLATrace.Emit(...)` block near the desired location.
2. Copy the block, insert it at the new location.
3. Change the `"event"` value to the new event name.
4. Add/remove fields as needed.
5. Add a corresponding `TraceXxx` action wrapper to `spec/Trace.tla` and add it to `TraceNext`.
6. Run `bash /Users/tess/dev/Specula/case-studies/smartbft/.specula-output/harness/run.sh`.

## How to Move a Capture Point

- Before → after: move the `TLATrace.Emit(...)` block past the desired statement.
- The most common adjustment is moving `decide` emit relative to `incrementCurrentDecisionsInView()` — it must be AFTER the increment so `getCurrentDecisionsInView()` returns the post-state value.

## How to Rebuild and Re-run

```bash
bash /Users/tess/dev/Specula/case-studies/smartbft/.specula-output/harness/run.sh
```

This resets the repo to clean state, re-applies the patch, rebuilds, runs all 4 tests in separate invocations, and reports trace line counts.

## State Capture Levels

All events use **Full** capture (all fields available at trigger point). The only exception:

- `hb_timeout` and `change_role` run inside the HBM goroutine. They only have access to HBM state (`hbm_*` fields). Controller state (`ctrl_view`, `ctrl_decisions`) is not captured because the HBM goroutine does not hold the controller lock. This is documented in `instrumentation-spec.md` Section 3.1.

## Test Scenarios and What They Cover

| Test | Trace File | Events Generated |
|------|-----------|------------------|
| `TestTLATraceNormal` | `trace_normal.ndjson` | `change_role`, `propose`, `pre_prepare`, `decide` |
| `TestTLATraceViewChange` | `trace_view_change.ndjson` | All normal + `hb_timeout`, `view_change_start`, `vc_same_seq`, `enter_new_view`, `update_view`, `update_decisions` |
| `TestTLATraceHBTimeout` | `trace_hb_timeout.ndjson` | `hb_timeout`, `view_change_start`, `enter_new_view`, `update_view`, `update_decisions`, `change_role` (multiple view changes) |
| `TestTLATraceVCDeliver` | `trace_vc_deliver.ndjson` | All view-change events + `vc_deliver`, `vc_validate` (Family 2 deliver-before-validate path) |

## Note on vc_deliver / vc_validate

These events fire only when the new leader is one sequence behind a VIEW_DATA sender. To reproduce: run `TestTLATraceVCDeliver`, which:

1. Disconnects node 2 (view-1 leader) before seq 1 is committed.
2. Lets nodes 1, 3, 4 commit seq 1 with quorum (3 of 4).
3. Disconnects node 1, reconnects node 2, triggers view change.
4. Node 2 (seq=0) receives VIEW_DATA from node 3 (seq=1) → `vc_deliver` + `vc_validate`.

## Note on hb_timeout

The `hb_timeout` event fires only when `LeaderHeartbeatTimeout` (1 minute in test config) elapses without a heartbeat from the leader. The tests use a manual clock channel (`n.heartbeatTime`) with time jumps of 90 seconds to trigger this instantly. Do NOT call `n.Consensus.Stop()` before `n.Setup()` in test setup — the Consensus was created by `newNode` but not yet started, so its internal ViewChanger is nil and Stop() would panic.

# SmartBFT Trace Instrumentation Guide

## Instrumented Events

| Event | Source File | Function / Location |
|---|---|---|
| `propose` | `internal/bft/controller.go` | Leader proposes a new request |
| `decide` | `internal/bft/controller.go` | Node reaches decision on a sequence number |
| `update_view` | `internal/bft/controller.go` | Current view number is updated |
| `update_decisions` | `internal/bft/controller.go` | Decisions map is updated after commit |
| `pre_prepare` | `internal/bft/view.go` | PrePrepare message is processed |
| `view_change_start` | `internal/bft/viewchanger.go` | Node initiates a view change |
| `vc_deliver` | `internal/bft/viewchanger.go` | ViewChange message is delivered |
| `vc_validate` | `internal/bft/viewchanger.go` | ViewChange quorum is validated |
| `vc_same_seq` | `internal/bft/viewchanger.go` | View change for same sequence detected |
| `enter_new_view` | `internal/bft/viewchanger.go` | Node enters a new view after VC completes |
| `hb_timeout` | `internal/bft/heartbeatmonitor.go` | Leader heartbeat timeout fires |
| `change_role` | `internal/bft/heartbeatmonitor.go` | Node role changes (leader/follower) |

## How to Add a Field to an Existing Event

1. Find the `Emit(...)` call for the event in the source file listed above.
2. Add the new key-value pair to the map passed to `Emit`.
3. Re-run `bash /Users/tess/dev/Specula/case-studies/smartbft/.specula-output/harness/run.sh`.

## How to Add a New Event

1. Find an existing `Emit(...)` call near the location you want to instrument.
2. Copy the block and paste it at the new location.
3. Change the `"event"` key value to the new event name.
4. Add or remove fields as needed.
5. Re-run `bash /Users/tess/dev/Specula/case-studies/smartbft/.specula-output/harness/run.sh`.

## How to Rebuild

```
bash /Users/tess/dev/Specula/case-studies/smartbft/.specula-output/harness/run.sh
```

This resets the repo, re-applies the patch, rebuilds, runs tests, and reports trace line counts.

## Note on hb_timeout

The `hb_timeout` event fires only when `LeaderHeartbeatTimeout` elapses without a heartbeat from
the leader. Use `TestTLATraceHBTimeout`, which drives a manual/fake clock to trigger the timeout
without waiting for wall-clock time.
